coxeter_handoff.meaning: choose the displayed geometric basis as the pinned standard F-marking and transport the 21 archived wall vectors.  They are divisor classes and their reflections are integral on the full NS of a very general member.

family.alternate_double_cover_model: Equivalently, X is the resolved double cover of the blow-up of P2 defining R, branched over the strict transforms of the marked nodal cubic and the marked smooth cubic.
family.base_field: C (or any algebraically closed field of characteristic zero)

nonempty_open_witness.claim_scope: this rational point proves the open is nonempty; its individual Picard lattice is not asserted to be generic

family.parameter_open: Disc_t(Q) is nonzero and 4*a4^3+27*b6^2 is nonzero.  Then Q has eleven simple nonzero roots, the fiber at infinity is smooth, and all twelve singular fibers of R are I1.
family.surface: the minimal resolution of the displayed Weierstrass model

fixed_locus_and_invariant_lattice.fixed_locus: one smooth elliptic fiber above infinity and the strict transform of the ramified nodal I1 fiber, a rational curve

geometric_integral_identification.<-2>: the nonidentity component C of the ramified I2 fiber; C^2=-2 and C is orthogonal to U and to the corrected Shioda classes
geometric_integral_identification.E8(-2): R has no reducible fibers, so its Mordell-Weil height lattice is E8.  Pullback of its eight Shioda classes under the degree-two base change doubles every pairing, giving the orthogonal divisor lattice E8(-2).
geometric_integral_identification.U: fiber f and O+f, where O is the zero section; their Gram is [[0,1],[1,0]]
geometric_integral_identification.saturation: all eleven displayed divisor classes are invariant.  Their lattice has determinant 2^9, equal to the determinant forced by (r,a,delta)=(11,9,1); hence its index in H^2(X,Z)^iota is one.

fixed_locus_and_invariant_lattice.ramified_i1_local_model: uv=t becomes uv=s^2; resolving the A1 singularity turns the fiber into I2.  Exactly the strict transform of the nodal fiber is pointwise fixed, not the exceptional component.

generic_full_picard.claim: NS(X)=U+E8(-2)+<-2> for a very general parameter
generic_full_picard.noether_lefschetz_step: The nine-dimensional family therefore dominates the nine-dimensional moduli component of (11,9,1) pairs.  Extra anti-invariant algebraic classes lie on the countable union of Noether-Lefschetz hyperplanes, so the very general member has NS equal to the invariant lattice.
generic_full_picard.normalization: PGL2 puts the ordered ramification fibers at 0 and infinity; short-Weierstrass homothety puts (A(0),B(0))=(-3,2); the remaining base scaling normalizes D'(0)=108.
generic_full_picard.quotient_recovery: From a generic pair (X,iota), the fixed elliptic curve gives the unique type-2 elliptic fibration.  Quotient by iota and contract the distinguished exceptional curve over the ramified I1 node to recover R and its ordered I1/smooth branch fibers.  Thus the normalized parameter-to-pair map has zero-dimensional generic fibers.
generic_full_picard.scope: exact for the geometric generic/very general member; the displayed rational witness only certifies nonemptiness

garbagnati_salgado_double_cover.use: quadratic base changes of rational elliptic surfaces; the branch-fiber table I0/I1 -> I0/I2 with fixed genus-1/rational curves; invariant-lattice classification

garbagnati_salgado_genus_one_classificat.use: Proposition 2.8 and Section 3: for k=1, r=11, a=9; the admissible rational elliptic surface has branch fibers I0+I1, eleven other I1 fibers, MW rank 8, and delta=1

nikulin_lattices.use: classification and uniqueness of even 2-elementary lattices

lineage.novelty_scope: The 2-elementary K3 class and the abstract Coxeter polytope are known.  The positive addition is an exact normalized equation, geometric full-Picard identification, and literal Gram handoff joining them in this project; no worldwide priority claim is made.

shioda_mordell_weil_lattices.use: height-lattice formalism and the E8 Mordell-Weil frame for a rational elliptic surface without reducible fibers

scope.positive_result: an equation-level very-general K3 variety whose full divisor lattice carries all 21 certified Coxeter reflections

theorem: On a nonempty Zariski-open subset of the displayed normalized nine-parameter family, the quadratic base change is an elliptic K3 with deck-invariant lattice U+E8(-2)+<-2>.  For a very general parameter this is the full Neron-Severi lattice.  Via the pinned standard Gram, it is an equation-level full-Picard carrier of the known A15_11 C02 finite-volume noncompact H10/21 Coxeter chamber.
